How it works

Photo to finished piece.

01

Send the photo

A clear picture of the people, pet or object — plus any note on pose, outfit or the message you want on the base.

02

We sculpt & confirm

You see the 3D model before anything prints, so likeness and detail get approved first.

03

Print & hand finish

Printed, cleaned, painted where needed and mounted on a base, ready to gift.
